title: Offsite signal analysis
purpose: Analyze observed offsite citations, backlinks, mentions, and referral evidence without inferring signals that were not supplied.
whenToUse: Evaluating backlinks, mentions, citations, referrals, and third-party presence.
steps: Inventory observed offsite signals by source.
Separate links, mentions, citations, and referrals.
Assess relevance and provenance of observed signals.
Identify evidence gaps and bounded outreach opportunities.
checks: Do not infer backlinks, AI referrals, citations, or mention status without observed inputs.
Do not convert upstream CITE-style gates or scores into authoritative system state.
outputs: Advisory offsite-signal summary, unknowns, and evidence-backed opportunities.
evidenceRules: Observed evidence must stay distinct from recommendations and third-party method guidance.
Missing observed data remains unknown and must never be converted to zero, failure, or success.
Any externally sourced benchmark or claim must retain provenance and applicability limits.
forbiddenInferences: Do not fabricate rankings, citations, traffic, conversions, backlinks, performance, or verification state.
Do not elevate advisory output into P7 authoritative facts, deterministic scores, P8 risk, approvals, mutation authority, or VERIFIED status.
Do not request or use credentials, execute commands, call networks, mutate databases, publish, deploy, merge, or perform runtime actions.
